scope: CPU-only direct RNS matrix workspace padding for five to seven actual columns, using an eight-column SIMD stride. Only actual columns are encoded, inverse transformed, reconstructed and returned. No key or input changes.

independent_validation.scope: Independent integer phases for full dense input, structured S2C output, real functional refresh and remaining-level square. All coefficients/slots; no key values printed; no security claim.

memory_limit: Padding adds public zero columns to two table buffers and four sum buffers. Selector key spectra and budgets are unchanged; process RSS remains separate.
timing_limit: One unpinned trial before and after padding. Other stages vary; whole-function paired pinned controls are recorded separately.
